description: Live NEAR protocol state of mainnet and testnet: the protocol version each runs and the newest its nodes support, the nearcore version, epoch progress, the stake-weighted upgrade vote of the block producers this epoch (with how much of the stake it was read from), the threshold, when voting for the next version starts according to the nearcore release notes, and which deprecations wait on that upgrade. Use when asked whether a protocol change (DelegateV2 removal, the gas rebate) is live yet, or when the next upgrade lands.
name: get_protocol_status
